base_uptime_ratio.formula: verified BASE-open minutes / required public-service minutes
base_uptime_ratio.reason: No approved pilot, baseline, operator or data agreement exists.

clear_path_conflict_rate.formula: verified obstruction or conflict events / audited operating hours
clear_path_conflict_rate.reason: No approved pilot, baseline, operator or data agreement exists.

transition_failure_rate.formula: failed or aborted transitions / attempted transitions
transition_failure_rate.reason: No approved pilot, baseline, operator or data agreement exists.

override_freeze_rate.formula: human veto or emergency freeze events / AI recommendations
override_freeze_rate.reason: No approved pilot, baseline, operator or data agreement exists.

appeal_remedy_time.reason: No approved pilot, baseline, operator or data agreement exists.

maintenance_staff_time.formula: staff time by carrier, state and service hour; never added to closure duration or event counts
maintenance_staff_time.reason: No approved pilot, baseline, operator or data agreement exists.

closure_duration.formula: closure duration by cause and carrier
closure_duration.reason: No approved pilot, baseline, operator or data agreement exists.

replacement_event_count.formula: count of component replacement events by carrier and cause
replacement_event_count.reason: No approved pilot, baseline, operator or data agreement exists.

equity_access_success_gap.formula: maximum audited difference in service-success ratio across approved privacy-preserving user conditions
equity_access_success_gap.reason: No approved pilot, baseline, operator or data agreement exists.

public_service_duration_gain.formula: AI-assisted service minutes minus best static/manual comparator under identical constraints
public_service_duration_gain.reason: No approved pilot, baseline, operator or data agreement exists.

public_service_fulfilled_request_gain.formula: AI-assisted fulfilled public requests minus best static/manual comparator under identical constraints
public_service_fulfilled_request_gain.reason: No approved pilot, baseline, operator or data agreement exists.

non_ai_task_completion_ratio.reason: No approved pilot, operator, baseline observation or data agreement exists; this record defines a future measurement and stop contract only.
non_ai_task_completion_ratio.measurement_window: daily sample by persona and time band
non_ai_task_completion_ratio.stop_threshold: below 0.95 in any protected persona group
non_ai_task_completion_ratio.recovery_condition: two consecutive verified windows at or above 0.95

no_login_task_completion_ratio.reason: No approved pilot, operator, baseline observation or data agreement exists; this record defines a future measurement and stop contract only.
no_login_task_completion_ratio.measurement_window: all sampled tasks requiring no account
no_login_task_completion_ratio.stop_threshold: below 0.95 or any login-only public task
no_login_task_completion_ratio.recovery_condition: paper/staffed route restored and independently retested

state_switch_time_minutes.reason: No approved pilot, operator, baseline observation or data agreement exists; this record defines a future measurement and stop contract only.
state_switch_time_minutes.stop_threshold: over 3 minutes or any ambiguous authority
state_switch_time_minutes.recovery_condition: mechanical lock and role drill pass twice

ai_closure_duration_minutes.reason: No approved pilot, operator, baseline observation or data agreement exists; this record defines a future measurement and stop contract only.
ai_closure_duration_minutes.stop_threshold: over 2 minutes or public route affected
ai_closure_duration_minutes.recovery_condition: safe isolation verified with public route open

return_acceptance_time_minutes.reason: No approved pilot, operator, baseline observation or data agreement exists; this record defines a future measurement and stop contract only.
return_acceptance_time_minutes.stop_threshold: over 15 minutes or any unresolved defect
return_acceptance_time_minutes.recovery_condition: route, surface, drainage, signs and complaints all cleared

equity_access_burden_gap_minutes.reason: No approved pilot, operator, baseline observation or data agreement exists; this record defines a future measurement and stop contract only.
equity_access_burden_gap_minutes.non_ai_baseline: median staffed BASE journey by persona
equity_access_burden_gap_minutes.stop_threshold: protected-group median exceeds reference by over 5 minutes
equity_access_burden_gap_minutes.recovery_condition: gap at or below 5 minutes for two windows

dazhongsi_base_active_service_area_sqm.formula: area(D1 + D2, EPSG:4548); retain unrounded projected component areas and round display to 0.01 sqm
dazhongsi_base_active_service_area_sqm.name_zh: 大钟寺基准情景主动服务面积
dazhongsi_base_active_service_area_sqm.recalculation_trigger: Recalculate after any D1-D3 geometry, component-selection or survey update.

dazhongsi_base_capacity_persons.formula: round_half_up(734.93 sqm * 0.40 usable fraction / 10 sqm per person, 1 person)
dazhongsi_base_capacity_persons.name_zh: 大钟寺基准情景算术容量
dazhongsi_base_capacity_persons.recalculation_trigger: Replace after verified occupancy, fire, accessibility and operating-layout review.

dazhongsi_base_annual_open_hours.formula: Base participant operating assumption; low/base/high = 900/1350/1800 hours per year
dazhongsi_base_annual_open_hours.name_zh: 大钟寺基准情景年度开放小时
dazhongsi_base_annual_open_hours.recalculation_trigger: Recalculate when an approved calendar or operator plan differs by more than 10%.

dazhongsi_base_fte_required.formula: fte_required_unrounded = 3 staffed positions * 1350 open hours/year * 1.18 coverage factor / 1600 productive hours/FTE-year = 2.986875 FTE; display fte_required = round_half_up(2.986875, 0.1 FTE) = 3.0 FTE
dazhongsi_base_fte_required.recalculation_trigger: Recalculate after approved hours, positions, coverage or productive-hours inputs.

dazhongsi_base_capex_rom_cny.formula: round_half_up((734.93 sqm * 4200 CNY/sqm + 800000 CNY equipment allowance) * 1.20, 50000 CNY)
dazhongsi_base_capex_rom_cny.name_zh: 大钟寺基准情景CAPEX数量级
dazhongsi_base_capex_rom_cny.recalculation_trigger: Replace when a professional estimate changes any rate or allowance by more than 20%.

dazhongsi_base_opex_annual_rom_cny.formula: round_half_up(2.986875 unrounded FTE * 200000 CNY/FTE-year + 1350 hours * 140 CNY/open-hour + 400000 CNY fixed allowance, 10000 CNY) = 1190000 CNY/year ROM
dazhongsi_base_opex_annual_rom_cny.name_zh: 大钟寺基准情景年度OPEX数量级
dazhongsi_base_opex_annual_rom_cny.recalculation_trigger: Replace after approved staffing, hours, wage, service-hour and fixed-cost inputs.

dazhongsi_no_build_capex_rom_cny.formula: base: 250000 CNY clear-line markings and bilingual wayfinding + 400000 CNY seating/shade + 250000 CNY staffed-window setup = 900000 CNY ROM; low/high use the corresponding published component bands
dazhongsi_no_build_capex_rom_cny.name_zh: 大钟寺不建设情景公共基底CAPEX数量级
dazhongsi_no_build_capex_rom_cny.recalculation_trigger: Replace after a professional public-base estimate and operator plan.

dazhongsi_no_build_opex_annual_rom_cny.formula: base: round_half_up(0.66375 unrounded FTE * 200000 CNY/FTE-year + 160000 CNY fixed manual-service allowance, 10000 CNY) = 290000 CNY/year ROM; low/high use the corresponding published bands
dazhongsi_no_build_opex_annual_rom_cny.name_zh: 大钟寺不建设情景年度OPEX数量级
dazhongsi_no_build_opex_annual_rom_cny.recalculation_trigger: Replace after approved staffed-window hours and loaded staff cost.
